segments.mil7.8.5:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘agadassa dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti.
segments.mil7.8.5:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, agade kimī na saṇṭhahanti, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena mānase kilesā na saṇṭhapetabbā.
segments.mil7.8.5:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, agadassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.5:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, agado daṭṭhaphuṭṭhadiṭṭhaasitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sabbaṃ visaṃ paṭihanati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena rāgadosamohamānadiṭṭhivisaṃ sabbaṃ paṭihanitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.8.5:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, agadassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
